newsitem.title: UK: UK says plans to sell off air traffic control.
newsitem.headline: UK says plans to sell off air traffic control.

text.p: British Transport Secretary Sir George Young said on Friday that the government planned to bring forward legislation early in the next parliament to privatise National Air Traffic Services.
He said in a written parliamentary answer it wanted to publish a draft bill as early as possible in 1997.
"The National Air Traffic Services face continuing demands for additional investment in the latest and most sophisticated equipment," Young said.
"The Government believes that these demands can most effectively be met in the private sector, freed from the constraints of public expenditure controls."
He said the government would draft proposals for a privatisation bill in consultation with the Civil Aviation and other interested parties.
